_comment: Curation policies — block packages that hit any of these conditions. Each entry maps directly to an xray_curation_policy resource. condition_id values reference predefined JFrog Curation conditions (see https://jfrog.com/help/r/jfrog-security-user-guide/products/curation/conditions for the full catalog).

policies.name: block_aged_package_with_newer_version
policies._condition: operational — Package version is aged (newer version available)

policies.name: block_aged_package_without_newer_version
policies._condition: operational — Package version is aged (no newer version identified)

policies.name: block_cvss_4to7_with_fix_version
policies._condition: security — CVE with CVSS score between 4.0 and 6.9 (fix version available)

policies.name: block_cvss_4to7_with_or_without_fix_version
policies._condition: security — CVE with CVSS score between 4.0 and 6.9 (with or without a fix version available)

policies.name: block_cvss_7to9_with_fix_version
policies._condition: security — CVE with CVSS score between 7.0 and 8.9 (fix version available)

policies.name: block_cvss_7to9_with_or_without_fix_version
policies._condition: security — CVE with CVSS score between 7.0 and 8.9 (with or without a fix version available)

policies.name: block_cvss_9to10_with_fix_version
policies._condition: security — CVE with CVSS score of 9 or above (fix version available)

policies.name: block_cvss_9to10_with_or_without_fix_version
policies._condition: security — CVE with CVSS score of 9 or above (with or without a fix version available)

policies.name: block_image_not_offical_docker_hub
policies._condition: operational — Image is not Docker Hub official

policies.name: block_license_AGPL
policies._condition: legal — Package license is GNU AGPL

policies.name: block_license_GPL
policies._condition: legal — Package license is GNU GPL

policies.name: block_license_LGPL
policies._condition: legal — Package license is GNU LGPL

policies.name: block_no_license
policies._condition: legal — Package has no identified license
